topography.project_purpose: RWA. Structurally: 38 project-authored contract(s) across 3 chain(s); 9 ERC4626 vaults, 11 ERC20 tokens, 2 Chainlink feeds; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 7 common project-authored base contract(s) (accesscontrolenumerable, erc165, erc20permit). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
